paragraphs: Rav Chanin bar Ashi: He reported in Shmuel’s name—Bekhorot 34a. Jerusalem Ketubot, chapter 2, halakhah 10, has R. Chama bar Ashi, and R. Yasa spoke in his name. Perhaps they are one person and there is a scribal error.
